subjects: ban on assault-style guns and large magazines

findings.passage: Technology is creating new firearms and devices at a dizzying rate. Keeping Massachusetts safe requires constant vigilance.
findings.note: Says states with the strongest gun laws have the lowest gun death rates, and that new gun technology needs constant attention. Quoted by the Marblehead Current.

findings.passage: I have yet to hear how any of these provisions create an undue burden on law-abiding gun owners.
findings.note: Says she has heard no case that the 2023 House gun bill burdens lawful gun owners; she defended reasonable gun regulation as constitutional. Quoted by the Marblehead Current.

findings.passage: Like many parents, I am fed up. I have witnessed our nation transformed by gun violence.
findings.note: Gives gun violence and parenthood as her reason for backing the 2023 House gun bill. Quoted by the Marblehead Current.

findings.passage: Guns are the number one killer of kids ages 1 through 25.
findings.note: Cites gun deaths among young people as a reason for the bill. Quoted by the Marblehead Current.

findings.passage: We are in the midst of a public health crisis and it is unrelenting. Thoughts and prayers are not enough.
findings.note: Calls gun violence a public health crisis and says thoughts and prayers are not enough. Quoted by the Marblehead Current.
